groups.note: The official 2026 Conservation District rural and at-large contests were write-in only; the official write-in canvass does not certify a named winner (the leading line on both is “NO NAME PROVIDED”), so those seats are not filled. The official 2024 Conservation District vote-for-2 contest is not labeled rural, urban, or at-large. The official 2022 Cemetery District vote-for-1 contest does not say unexpired, so that term length is marked uncertain. Municipal, school, and special-district names from the official 2012–2018 image reports are not yet fully keyed, and those January seats are marked Not yet collected rather than invented.

groups.note: Supreme Court justices are the five who were in office this January, using official Wyoming Judicial Branch appointment and retirement dates together with official retention results. District and circuit rows are the 6th Judicial District judges (the district also includes Crook and Weston) who appeared by name on a Campbell County official retention ballot in an adjoining cycle; the official 2022 general lists “DC JUDGE” and “CC JUDGE” without a judge’s name, and those two retentions are not attached to a named holder.
